code.purpose: Code and technical source material only.

motion.name: ledger-rule
motion.purpose: Draw the archive underline on hover or keyboard focus.

components.name: Archive Entry
components.description: A date and wrapping post title in the chronological ledger.
components.css: .ds-archive { display:grid; grid-template-columns:5rem 1fr; gap:2rem; font-family:Arvo,serif; color:#303030; } .ds-archive time { color:#686868; font-size:.8125rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-archive a { color:currentColor; text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.2em; } .ds-archive a:hover { color:#686868; } .ds-archive a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #4d4a45; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Text Control
components.description: The quiet theme/language control used in the masthead.
components.css: .ds-control { min-width:2rem; min-height:2rem; border:0; background:transparent; color:#686868; font:700 .75rem Arvo,serif; text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.25em; cursor:pointer; } .ds-control:hover { color:#303030; } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #4d4a45; outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview: The blog is a durable paper journal translated directly to the web: restrained, chronological, and led by typography.

rules.name: Ink-Only
rules.body: Do not introduce a brand accent for navigation or links.

rules.name: Flat Ledger
rules.body: Do not add shadows, floating cards, translucent layers, or decorative depth.

dos: Do let chronology, whitespace, and typography create hierarchy.
Do wrap long Chinese and English titles at every width.
donts: Don’t use card grids, thumbnails, summaries, or promotional heroes for the archive.
